en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view from a hillside over a valley with fields, scattered buildings, and low mountains in the background. On the right edge, a building with large windows and timber details stands dramatically on a steep, wooded slope. The upper half of the front is filled with handwritten cursive text. Printed near the top appears a caption identifying the view as a castellated structure on the Schlossberg.
